name: Oku-sama wa Zansatsu Shoujo
source:
Main character is a promising office worker in a trade company. His wife Sayuri is a cute junior high school student. The newly-wed couple enjoys each other during a period of one week.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家贸易公司的优秀职员。他的妻子小百合是一名可爱的初中生。这对新婚夫妻享受着一周的二人生活。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
